content:
Welcome to Hooks.gg, the ultimate free message building tool for community builders!


Here you can easily create beautiful custom messages for your server to engage and communicate with your members.


To get started, click or tap on anything you want to edit! Use the menu in the top right to log in and access advanced features like cloud saves and shared messages.


If you ever need any assistance, reach out to us in our support server and we'll be happy to help you!
